items.title: Lifting maps from a smooth algebra along a henselian pair
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that every algebra map from a smooth algebra into the quotient of a henselian pair lifts to the ring itself. The proof base changes the smooth algebra along the ring, obtaining a smooth algebra over the ring to which the lifting statement for smooth morphisms applies, and thus an etale extension of the ring inducing an isomorphism on the quotient together with an algebra map into it. The henselian property of the pair supplies a section of that etale extension, and composing the two maps gives the required lift.
